projects.name: Project-3
details: Description: Bill Gosling Outsourcing, a multinational corporation
headquartered in Barrie, Canada, operates across seven countries as a
leading BPO provider under the BGO brand, delivering services to a diverse
portfolio of clients across various industries.
Role and Responsibilities:
• Developed KPI dashboards using Discovery  Boards,  allowing  users  to filter, drill-down, and interact with  visual  data  in  real-time  In
Workday Prism.
• Built reusable data pipelines in Prism,  enabling  scalable  ingestion
and transformation of external data.
• Created multi-source datasets by blending Workday and  external  data,
enabling 360-degree analysis of HR, Finance, and Operations metrics.
• Developed analytics Dashboards  utilizing  multiple  data  sources  to provide actionable reporting and embedded analytics.
• Experienced in analyzing and preparing Project  Deliverables  such  as
Technical Design Document (TDD) and Functional Design Document (FDD).
• Integrations in Workday using  different  tools  like  CCW,  EIB,  DT,
Custom Report and Workday
• Worked on Integration Systems (EIBs, Core Connectors).
• Created calculated fields and Worked on Simple and Advanced Reports.
• Responsible for supporting the new change  requests  and  enhancements
in the Project
• Design of web services to send/receive data between Workday and  Third
party system.
• Created test scripts and coordinated the testing effort with  all  the
stakeholders for System and UAT.
• Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD), design  specifications,
and  User  Acceptance  Testing   (UAT)   documentation,   along   with
comprehensive test scenarios to  support  Workday  implementation  and
validation.

projects.name: Project 2
details: Description: The Bank of America Corporation is an American multinational
investment bank and financial services holding company headquartered at the
Bank of America Corporate Center in Charlotte, North Carolina, with
investment banking and auxiliary headquarters in Manhattan. The bank was
founded in San Francisco, California.
Role and Responsibilities:
• Understanding the Business Requirements  by  studying  the  Functional
Documents.
• Responsible for Resolving the Tickets,  integrations Maintenance,  and
Support, Regular Status meeting with  integration lead  and  providing
the status update of integration.
• Involved in calls with client and update the work status  as  well  as
clarifications if any.
•  Handled  Workday  Service  Upgrade  Testing   for  all  the  existing
integrations .
• Design, Build, Test, and  Deploy  Integration  solutions  for  Workday
Customers.
•  Creating  Supervisory  organizations,  Matrix   organizations,   Cost
centers, Location and their  hierarchies,  Job  profiles,  Job  family
groups and maintained them.
• Worked in preparation  of  reports  to  extract  employee  information
from the HR data from HR  associates  and  partners  and  provided  to functional team.
• Understanding the Business Requirements  by  studying  the  Functional
Documents.
• Created various EIB outbound integrations for sending  employees  data
from Workday system to external DW System.
•  Created  and  Enhanced  various  custom  reports  and  migrated  into various tenants .
• Developed various workday studio  inbound  and  outbound  integrations
across systems.
• Created Various  custom  reports  types(Advanced,  matrix,  Composite,
Trading)   as  per  the  client  requirement  and  preparing  the  UTP
documents.
• Created EIB Inbound Integrations for loading  the  employees  personal
Information  like,  Emergency  contacts,  Compensation,  Bank  account
information, cost center information.
• Involved in  creating  and  supporting  various  integration  projects
involving EIB, Core Connector and Workday Studio.
• Involved in calls with client and update the work status  as  well  as
clarifications if any.
• Developed Several Complex Integrations using Workday Studio and EIB.
• Hands  on  Workday  systems  integration  experience  building  custom
integrations using Cloud Connect and Document Transformation.
• Hands-on experience In  Migrating  the  XSLT  Code,  Reports,  workday
studio,  EIB,  DT  integrations   from  Lower  tenet  to  Sandbox  and
Production using Object Transporter.
